```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# FIGURE 6 — RL000094: 5' LTR SUBGROUPS, UMR OVERLAP, AND HEAT EXPRESSION
#
# Standalone script reconstructed from the original analysis used for slide 6.
#
# Figure panels:
#   A. Structural relationship within full-sequence family RL000094
#   B. UMR overlap frequency for 5' LTR families RL000099 and RL000584
#   C. Mean heat expression of individual TEs, with UMR status indicated by shape
#
# This script rebuilds all required objects from the original input files.
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. INPUT / OUTPUT PATHS
# ==============================================================================

scratch_dir <-
  "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/stress_scratch_copy/stress_scratch"

b73_status_path <-
  "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/family_analysis/clustering_discordance_results/B73_individual_TE_clustering_status.tsv"

umr_overlap_path <-
  file.path(
    scratch_dir,
    "structural_LTRs_overlap_UMR.tsv"
  )

counts_path <-
  file.path(
    scratch_dir,
    "raw_counts_structural_LTRs_only.txt"
  )

metadata_path <-
  file.path(
    scratch_dir,
    "metadata.csv"
  )

output_dir <-
  "/users/2/menar060/final_panel_figures"

figure6_output_dir <-
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Figure6_RL000094"
  )

dir.create(
  figure6_output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. COLORS
# ==============================================================================

rl000094_colors <- c(
  "RL000099" = "#2AA198",
  "RL000584" = "#984EA3"
)

family_levels <- c(
  "RL000099",
  "RL000584"
)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. LOAD B73 STRUCTURAL TE FAMILY ASSIGNMENTS
# ==============================================================================

if (!file.exists(b73_status_path)) {
  stop(
    "Could not find B73 clustering-status file:\n",
    b73_status_path
  )
}

b73_te_assignments <- readr::read_tsv(
  b73_status_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

required_family_columns <- c(
  "TE_ID",
  "TE_Name",
  "LTR_Identity",
  "Classification",
  "Chromosome",
  "TE_Start",
  "TE_End",
  "Full_Seq_Family",
  "Five_Prime_Family",
  "Clustering_Status"
)

missing_family_columns <- setdiff(
  required_family_columns,
  names(b73_te_assignments)
)

if (length(missing_family_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in B73 clustering-status file: ",
    paste(missing_family_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

structural_family_table <- b73_te_assignments %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(required_family_columns)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(TE_ID),
    !is.na(Full_Seq_Family),
    !is.na(Five_Prime_Family)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    TE_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 5. LOAD TE × UMR OVERLAP
#
# The original bedtools intersect output stores the structural TE ID in V4.
# Any structural TE absent from this file is treated as not overlapping a UMR.
# ==============================================================================

if (!file.exists(umr_overlap_path)) {
  stop(
    "Could not find structural TE × UMR overlap file:\n",
    umr_overlap_path
  )
}

umr_overlap <- read.table(
  umr_overlap_path,
  sep = "\t",
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  quote = "",
  fill = TRUE
)

umr_te_lookup <- umr_overlap %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    TE_ID = as.character(V4),
    UMR_Overlap = TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl("^LTRRT_", TE_ID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    TE_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

family_umr_master <- structural_family_table %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    TE_ID = as.character(TE_ID),
    TE_Name = as.character(TE_Name),

    Full_Family_ID = sub(
      "^B73_Full_(Fam_)?",
      "",
      as.character(Full_Seq_Family)
    ),

    Five_Prime_Family_ID = sub(
      "^B73_5prime_(Fam_)?",
      "",
      as.character(Five_Prime_Family)
    ),

    Clustering_Status = as.character(Clustering_Status)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    umr_te_lookup,
    by = "TE_ID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    UMR_Overlap = tidyr::replace_na(
      UMR_Overlap,
      FALSE
    ),

    UMR_Status = dplyr::if_else(
      UMR_Overlap,
      "UMR overlap",
      "No UMR overlap"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    TE_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 6. REBUILD LOG2(CPM + 1) EXPRESSION MATRIX
#
# This matches the expression preprocessing used for the other major figures:
#   - fractional featureCounts matrix
#   - retain TEs with count > 1 in at least 2 samples
#   - CPM normalization by filtered library size
#   - log2(CPM + 1)
#   - remove zero-variance TEs
# ==============================================================================

if (!file.exists(counts_path)) {
  stop(
    "Could not find structural TE count matrix:\n",
    counts_path
  )
}

raw_counts <- readr::read_tsv(
  counts_path,
  comment = "#",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

annotation_columns <- c(
  "Geneid",
  "Chr",
  "Start",
  "End",
  "Strand",
  "Length"
)

sample_columns <- setdiff(
  names(raw_counts),
  annotation_columns
)

count_df <- raw_counts %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Geneid,
    dplyr::all_of(sample_columns)
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(count_df) <- count_df$Geneid
count_df$Geneid <- NULL

clean_sample_name <- function(x) {
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- sub("_Aligned.*$", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\.bam$", "", x)
  x
}

colnames(count_df) <- clean_sample_name(
  colnames(count_df)
)

count_df[] <- lapply(
  count_df,
  as.numeric
)

# ==============================================================================
# 7. LOAD AND MATCH SAMPLE METADATA
# ==============================================================================

if (!file.exists(metadata_path)) {
  stop(
    "Could not find metadata file:\n",
    metadata_path
  )
}

metadata <- read.csv(
  metadata_path,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if ("SampleID" %in% names(metadata)) {
  rownames(metadata) <- metadata$SampleID
} else {
  rownames(metadata) <- metadata[[1]]
}

if (!"Condition" %in% names(metadata)) {
  stop("metadata.csv must contain a Condition column.")
}

metadata$Condition <- as.character(
  metadata$Condition
)

common_samples <- intersect(
  colnames(count_df),
  rownames(metadata)
)

if (length(common_samples) < 2) {
  stop(
    "Fewer than two samples matched between counts and metadata."
  )
}

count_df <- count_df[
  ,
  common_samples,
  drop = FALSE
]

metadata <- metadata[
  common_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(count_df),
    rownames(metadata)
  )
)

count_matrix <- as.matrix(
  count_df
)

storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "numeric"

minimum_count <- 1
minimum_samples <- 2

keep_expressed <- rowSums(
  count_matrix > minimum_count
) >= minimum_samples

count_matrix_filtered <- count_matrix[
  keep_expressed,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

library_sizes <- colSums(
  count_matrix_filtered
)

cpm_matrix <- sweep(
  count_matrix_filtered,
  2,
  library_sizes,
  "/"
) * 1000000

log_cpm_matrix <- log2(
  cpm_matrix + 1
)

te_variance <- apply(
  log_cpm_matrix,
  1,
  stats::var
)

keep_variable <- is.finite(
  te_variance
) & te_variance > 0

log_cpm_variable <- log_cpm_matrix[
  keep_variable,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# ==============================================================================
# 8. SELECT RL000094 AND ITS TWO MAJOR 5' LTR SUBGROUPS
# ==============================================================================

rl000094_members <- family_umr_master %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Full_Family_ID == "RL000094",
    Five_Prime_Family_ID %in% family_levels,
    TE_ID %in% rownames(log_cpm_variable)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Five_Prime_Family_ID = factor(
      Five_Prime_Family_ID,
      levels = family_levels
    ),

    UMR_Status = factor(
      UMR_Status,
      levels = c(
        "No UMR overlap",
        "UMR overlap"
      )
    )
  )

if (nrow(rl000094_members) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No expressed RL000094 members were found."
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 9. SUMMARY FOR PANELS A AND B
# ==============================================================================

rl000094_plot_summary <- rl000094_members %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Five_Prime_Family_ID
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Number_TEs = dplyr::n(),
    Number_UMR = sum(UMR_Overlap),
    Percent_UMR = 100 * mean(UMR_Overlap),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(
  rl000094_plot_summary,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)

n_099 <- rl000094_plot_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Five_Prime_Family_ID == "RL000099"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Number_TEs)

n_584 <- rl000094_plot_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Five_Prime_Family_ID == "RL000584"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Number_TEs)

# ==============================================================================
# 10. PANEL A — STRUCTURAL RELATIONSHIP
# ==============================================================================

pA <- ggplot2::ggplot() +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 2,
    xend = 2,
    y = 2.35,
    yend = 1.85,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 3,
    y = 1.85,
    yend = 1.85,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 1,
    y = 1.85,
    yend = 1.45,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 3,
    xend = 3,
    y = 1.85,
    yend = 1.45,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 1.25,
    xmax = 2.75,
    ymin = 2.35,
    ymax = 3.05,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2,
    y = 2.70,
    label = "Full sequence\nRL000094",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0.35,
    xmax = 1.65,
    ymin = 0.65,
    ymax = 1.45,
    fill = rl000094_colors["RL000099"],
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = 1.05,
    label = paste0(
      "5' LTR\nRL000099\nn = ",
      n_099
    ),
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.6
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 2.35,
    xmax = 3.65,
    ymin = 0.65,
    ymax = 1.45,
    fill = rl000094_colors["RL000584"],
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 3,
    y = 1.05,
    label = paste0(
      "5' LTR\nRL000584\nn = ",
      n_584
    ),
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.6
  ) +

  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0.1, 3.9),
    ylim = c(0.45, 3.2),
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  ggplot2::theme_void() +

  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
      10,
      10,
      10,
      10
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 11. PANEL B — UMR OVERLAP
# ==============================================================================

pB <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  rl000094_plot_summary,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = Five_Prime_Family_ID,
    y = Percent_UMR,
    fill = Five_Prime_Family_ID
  )
) +

  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.65,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(
      label = paste0(
        round(Percent_UMR, 0),
        "%"
      )
    ),
    vjust = -0.45,
    size = 3.7,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(
      y = pmax(
        Percent_UMR / 2,
        8
      ),
      label = paste0(
        Number_UMR,
        "/",
        Number_TEs
      )
    ),
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = rl000094_colors
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 105),
    breaks = c(
      0,
      25,
      50,
      75,
      100
    ),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0)
    )
  ) +

  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "5' LTR family",
    y = "TEs overlapping a UMR (%)"
  ) +

  ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 12. BUILD HEAT-EXPRESSION DATA FOR PANEL C
#
# Panel C uses actual mean heat expression, log2(CPM + 1), rather than
# within-TE scaled expression or heat-minus-control response.
# ==============================================================================

rl000094_expression_matrix <- log_cpm_variable[
  as.character(
    rl000094_members$TE_ID
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

rl000094_expression_long <- as.data.frame(
  rl000094_expression_matrix
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "TE_ID"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -TE_ID,
    names_to = "Sample_ID",
    values_to = "Expression"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    rl000094_members %>%
      dplyr::select(
        TE_ID,
        Five_Prime_Family_ID,
        UMR_Status
      ),
    by = "TE_ID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    metadata %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column(
        "Sample_ID"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Sample_ID,
        Condition
      ),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  )

rl000094_heat_expression <- rl000094_expression_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    tolower(Condition) == "heat"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    TE_ID,
    Five_Prime_Family_ID,
    UMR_Status
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean_Heat_Expression = mean(
      Expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Five_Prime_Family_ID = factor(
      Five_Prime_Family_ID,
      levels = family_levels
    ),

    UMR_Status = factor(
      UMR_Status,
      levels = c(
        "No UMR overlap",
        "UMR overlap"
      )
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 13. WILCOXON TEST FOR PANEL C
# ==============================================================================

heat_expression_test <- stats::wilcox.test(
  Mean_Heat_Expression ~ Five_Prime_Family_ID,
  data = rl000094_heat_expression,
  exact = FALSE
)

heat_expression_p <- heat_expression_test$p.value

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "RL000094 HEAT EXPRESSION TEST\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "W = ",
  unname(heat_expression_test$statistic),
  "\n",
  "p = ",
  signif(heat_expression_p, 4),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

# ==============================================================================
# 14. GROUP MEDIANS FOR PANEL C
# ==============================================================================

rl000094_heat_medians <- rl000094_heat_expression %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Five_Prime_Family_ID
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Median_Heat_Expression = median(
      Mean_Heat_Expression,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

heat_min <- min(
  rl000094_heat_expression$Mean_Heat_Expression,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

heat_max <- max(
  rl000094_heat_expression$Mean_Heat_Expression,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

heat_range <- heat_max - heat_min

if (!is.finite(heat_range) || heat_range == 0) {
  heat_range <- 1
}

bracket_y <- heat_max + 0.10 * heat_range
bracket_tip <- bracket_y - 0.05 * heat_range
text_y <- bracket_y + 0.06 * heat_range

# ==============================================================================
# 15. PANEL C — MEAN HEAT EXPRESSION
# ==============================================================================

pC <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  rl000094_heat_expression,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = Five_Prime_Family_ID,
    y = Mean_Heat_Expression
  )
) +

  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(
      color = Five_Prime_Family_ID,
      shape = UMR_Status
    ),
    position = ggplot2::position_jitter(
      width = 0.07,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    size = 3.4,
    stroke = 1.1,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +

  ggplot2::geom_crossbar(
    data = rl000094_heat_medians,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = Five_Prime_Family_ID,
      y = Median_Heat_Expression,
      ymin = Median_Heat_Expression,
      ymax = Median_Heat_Expression,
      color = Five_Prime_Family_ID
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.42,
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +

  # p-value bracket
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 2,
    y = bracket_y,
    yend = bracket_y,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 1,
    y = bracket_y,
    yend = bracket_tip,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 2,
    xend = 2,
    y = bracket_y,
    yend = bracket_tip,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = text_y,
    label = paste0(
      "p = ",
      format.pval(
        heat_expression_p,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 0.001
      )
    ),
    size = 3.7
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = rl000094_colors,
    name = "5' LTR family"
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "No UMR overlap" = 1,
      "UMR overlap" = 16
    ),
    name = "UMR status"
  ) +

  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(
      mult = c(0.04, 0.18)
    )
  ) +

  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "5' LTR family",
    y = "Mean heat expression\nlog2(CPM + 1)"
  ) +

  ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    legend.position = "top",

    legend.box = "vertical",

    legend.box.just = "left",

    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  ) +

  ggplot2::guides(
    color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      title = "5' LTR family",
      order = 1
    ),

    shape = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      title = "UMR status",
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(
        color = "black"
      )
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 16. COMBINE PANELS
#
# Widths reproduce the overall structure of slide 6 while leaving additional
# room for Panel C and its legends.
# ==============================================================================

figure6 <-
  pA +
  pB +
  pC +
  patchwork::plot_layout(
    widths = c(
      0.9,
      0.8,
      1.25
    )
  ) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A"
  ) &
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.tag = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 23
    ),
    plot.tag.position = c(
      0.01,
      0.99
    )
  )

print(
  figure6
)

# ==============================================================================
# 17. SAVE FIGURE
# ==============================================================================

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure6_output_dir,
    "Figure6_RL000094_UMR_heat_expression.jpeg"
  ),
  plot = figure6,
  width = 12,
  height = 5.2,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure6_output_dir,
    "Figure6_RL000094_UMR_heat_expression.pdf"
  ),
  plot = figure6,
  width = 12,
  height = 5.2,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

# ==============================================================================
# 18. SAVE FIGURE-SPECIFIC DATA / STATISTICS
# ==============================================================================

readr::write_tsv(
  rl000094_plot_summary,
  file.path(
    figure6_output_dir,
    "Figure6_RL000094_UMR_summary.tsv"
  )
)

readr::write_tsv(
  rl000094_heat_expression,
  file.path(
    figure6_output_dir,
    "Figure6_RL000094_heat_expression.tsv"
  )
)

figure6_statistics <- tibble::tibble(
  Comparison =
    "RL000099 vs RL000584 mean heat expression",
  Test =
    "Wilcoxon rank-sum test",
  W =
    unname(
      heat_expression_test$statistic
    ),
  P_value =
    heat_expression_p
)

readr::write_tsv(
  figure6_statistics,
  file.path(
    figure6_output_dir,
    "Figure6_statistics.tsv"
  )
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "FIGURE 6 COMPLETE\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "\nJPEG:\n",
  file.path(
    figure6_output_dir,
    "Figure6_RL000094_UMR_heat_expression.jpeg"
  ),
  "\n\nPDF:\n",
  file.path(
    figure6_output_dir,
    "Figure6_RL000094_UMR_heat_expression.pdf"
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

```
